## ViewportToolbar() function

Shared pan/zoom toolbar for any [useViewport()](./core.useviewport.md)<!-- -->-backed component (MultipleSequenceAlignment, GeneModel, PhyloTree, GenomeBrowser), built on shadcn/ui's `Button`<!-- -->. `axes` controls which pan directions are shown — a 1D viewport (e.g. GeneModel's genomic coordinate) only needs `"x"`<!-- -->.
